tasks.prompt: Inspect fact.csv and return its machine-readable column names and types.
Return event_id and drug_id from fact.parquet where value is at least 0.999, ordered by event_id, as JSON Lines on stdout.
Join fact.parquet to dim.parquet by drug_id and write Parquet containing observation count by drug_class ordered by drug_class.
Convert all rows and columns of fact.csv to a new Parquet file without replacing an existing path.
Convert event_id, drug_id, event_date, value, and payload from fact.parquet to a new JSON Lines file.
Sort fact.parquet by value descending and event_id ascending using a 128 MiB memory budget, two threads, an explicit spill directory, and a 2 GiB spill cap.
Run a deliberately expensive read-only query with a 10 ms deadline and report the structured timeout failure without treating partial stdout as complete.
Attempt to write a query result to a path that already exists and preserve the original file unchanged.
